channel.title: Code Orange Dev School Articles
channel.description: Articles on Bitcoin self-custody, privacy, and open-source development from Code Orange Dev School.

item.title: Privacy Isn't About Hiding. It's About Protection.
item.description: Bitcoin is pseudonymous, not anonymous. Here is how your balance, spending and IP address can leak, and the simple habits (fresh addresses, your own node, PayJoin, Silent Payments) that protect you.
item.dc:creator: Andy

item.title: Why Our AI + Bitcoin Meetups Bring 3x More People
item.description: People come to our meetups to vibe code with AI and leave with a Lightning wallet, a node and an agent that can earn sats. Here is what we learned running AI + Bitcoin workshops in Bali and on Discord.
item.dc:creator: Andy

item.title: We Tried to Mine a Bitcoin Block With a BitAxe
item.description: At our Bitcoin mining workshop we plugged in a BitAxe and agreed to split the 3.125 BTC reward if we found a block. Here is what a tiny home miner teaches you about proof of work, pools, energy and 51% attacks.
item.dc:creator: Andy

item.title: How to Become a Bitcoin Developer in 2026: A Free Roadmap
item.description: A free, step-by-step roadmap to becoming a Bitcoin developer in 2026: what to learn first, free courses, your first open-source contribution, and getting funded.
item.dc:creator: Andy

item.title: Just Show Up: Why Learning Bitcoin Together Works
item.description: Online on Discord or around a table at Bitcoin House Bali, learning Bitcoin with other people is faster and friendlier. Here is why to show up.
item.dc:creator: Andy

item.title: Why Self-Custody Matters: Get Your Bitcoin Off the Exchange
item.description: Why leaving bitcoin on an exchange means holding an IOU, and three simple steps to start self-custody with a hardware wallet and a tested seed phrase backup.
item.dc:creator: Andy
